cards.lore: The Social-Interface. Most matches are won or lost in the first 5 minutes of talking.
cards.power: The Narrative-Unlock. Listens to the Wrestler's Story to build the Initial-Differential.

cards.lore: Visual pattern recognition. The Wrestler-Body wears its Name-Tag on its skin if you know how to look.
cards.power: The Surface-Scan. Sees the Butterfly-Rash and Cyanosis-Blue before a word is spoken.

cards.lore: Haptic feedback. Using the hands as a Manometer to judge tissue tension.
cards.power: The Deep-Touch. Feels the Liver-Edge and Rebound-Scream to find internal structural riots.

cards.lore: Acoustic resonance. Different densities produce different Sound-Stats. The low-tech ultrasound.
cards.power: The Echo-Check. Taps walls to hear if Lung-Balloons are full of Drown-Water or Air-Ghosts.

cards.lore: Acoustic amplification. Bridges the External-Arena to the Internal-Soundtrack.
cards.power: The Internal-Whisper. Amplifies Valve-Clicks and Lung-Crackles to hear the Rhythm-Rebels.

cards.lore: The Monosynaptic-Loop. A hardware test bypassing conscious control.
cards.power: The Circuit-Test. Taps Nerve-Triggers to see if the Brain-Bunker connects to the Muscle-Engine.

cards.lore: Hemodynamics. Uses a Pressure-Squeeze to briefly halt the Blood-Flow-River.
cards.power: The Pressure-Verdict. Measures Highway-Pressure to find Shock-the-Stumble.

cards.lore: Core temperature monitoring. The thermal-sensor for systemic metabolic activity.
cards.power: The Riot-Indicator. Measures Arena-Heat. High heat means the Immune-Army is brawling.

cards.lore: Direct visualization of the Middle-Ear-Arena. A micro-spotlight for narrow tunnels.
cards.power: The Drum-Check. Looks through the Ear-Tunnel to see if the Eardrum-Shield is broken.

cards.lore: Direct observation of microvasculature. The only place to see Vessel-Vines without a scalpel.
cards.power: The Window-to-the-Brain. Looks at the Retinal-Wallpaper to see pressure signs from the brain.

cards.lore: Surface microscopic visualization. Removes Skin-Glare to see internal architecture.
cards.power: The Pattern-Magnifier. Looks through Surface-Reflection to see deep mole pigment patterns.

cards.lore: Direct visualization of the Airway-Entrance. Essential for choke-matches.
cards.power: The Throat-Gateway. Pulls back the Tongue Wall to see cords and clear the path for the Breath-Pipe.

cards.lore: Venous access. The docking-port for systemic interventions.
cards.power: The Supply-Line. Creates a permanent bridge into the Blood-River for Chemical-Allies.

cards.lore: Targeted medication delivery. The sniper-rifle of the pharmacy.
cards.power: The Precision-Strike. Delivers a micro-dose of medicine directly into a muscle or vein.

cards.lore: Surgical access. The ultimate physical differential-solver—open the door if you can't see.
cards.power: The Arena-Breach. Opens the Wrestler-Body-Walls so the Blade-Brigade can fix the internal riot.

cards.lore: Urinary decompression. Bypasses lower Obstruction-Outlaws.
cards.power: The Reservoir-Empty. Snakes through the Exit-Tunnel to drain the Bladder-Basin.

cards.lore: Acoustic reflection. Sound waves bounce off Organ-Walls to build a live-action map.
cards.power: The Immediate-Reveal. Looks into the Belly-Arena at the bedside to find Internal-Leaks instantly.

cards.lore: Real-time cardiac ultrasound. Measures flow-velocity and wall-motion.
cards.power: The Engine-Scan. Watches Valve-Doors and Muscle-Walls in real-time to see why the pump stalls.

cards.lore: Frequency shift. Measures the speed of moving red cells to identify blockages.
cards.power: The Traffic-Cop. Hears the speed of the Blood-River to find the Clot-Monster blocking the pipe.

cards.lore: Identifying free fluid in potential spaces. Calls the Blade-Brigade immediately if positive.
cards.power: The Leak-Hunter. Scans 4 pits to see if Internal-Bleed-Hank is hiding after a crash.

cards.lore: Ionizing radiation. Dense structures block photons, casting a white shadow on the plate.
cards.power: The Skeleton-Reveal. Shines light through flesh to see snapped Bone-Pillars or Gunk in the lungs.

cards.lore: Radiopaque material. Fills hollow spaces to map internal flow-highways.
cards.power: The Highway-Glow. Injected to Light-up tunnels so Roent-the-Shadow can see them.

cards.lore: Real-time X-ray (Fluoroscopy). Guides the Stent-Builder into the correct spot.
cards.power: The Road-Map. Shows exactly where a Clot-Monster has blocked a Heart-Pipe.

cards.lore: High-density contrast. Does not absorb, mapping the geography of the GI-Arena perfectly.
cards.power: The Tunnel-Map. Coats the Gut-Walls to show if there is an Apple-Core narrowing the exit.

cards.lore: Rotating X-ray source. Identifies Stroke-Mist and Internal-Bleed with high speed.
cards.power: The 3D-Cross-Section. Spins thousands of Roent-Shadows into a sliceable 3D-Virtual-Wrestler.

cards.lore: Fast CT combined with IV contrast. The gold standard for sudden cardiovascular catastrophes.
cards.power: The Pipe-Watch. Uses a rapid contrast flash to see if Lung-Highways are blocked before O2 crashes.

cards.lore: Ultra-thin slices focused on lung parenchyma. Sees Pattern-Secrets standard CT misses.
cards.power: The Micro-Lung-View. Looks at tiny Air-Sacs to find Scar-Fiona or Emphysem-the-Pop.

cards.lore: Numerical scale of radiodensity. Allows the Slice-Master to be mathematically precise.
cards.power: The Tissue-Typer. Looks at a grey spot and judges if it's Air-Ghost, Fluid-Pool, or Solid-Tumor.

cards.lore: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance. Flips the Proton-Spin of water molecules to build a high-resolution map.
cards.power: The Soft-Tissue-God. Uses magnetism to see Brain-Wiring and Tumor-Miners with perfect clarity.

cards.lore: Imaging focused on moving protons. Maps the Vessel-Vines using only the magnetic field.
cards.power: The Shadow-Highway. Sees blood flow without Contrast-the-Painter, safe for renal-failure wrestlers.

cards.lore: Brownian motion of water. In acute stroke, water gets trapped inside cells, glowing bright white.
cards.power: The Ischemia-Blinker. Finds where cells are swelling and dying, catching a Stroke-Stall long before CT.

cards.lore: Paramagnetic enhancement. Shortens Proton-Reset-Time, making specific tissues glow brilliantly.
cards.power: The Breach-Finder. Highlights where the Blood-Brain-Barrier is broken by tumors or scars.

cards.lore: Positron Emission Tomography. Active cells (Cancer, Inflammation) consume more glucose.
cards.power: The Hunger-Map. Uses Radio-Sugar to see who is eating the most. Malignant-Max is always hungry.

cards.lore: Nuclear isotope mapping. A Mismatch is the signature of a Pulmonary Embolus.
cards.power: The Air-vs-Flow-Check. Compares Air-Balloons to Blood-Highways. If air goes in but blood doesn't, it's a clot.

cards.lore: Osteoblastic activity. The tracer binds to hydroxyapatite where new bone is being laid down.
cards.power: The Repair-Radar. Looks for where Bone-Builders are working overtime fixing fractures or fighting tumors.

cards.lore: Hepatobiliary scintigraphy. Tracks the functional flow-logic of bile through the pipes.
cards.power: The Bile-Highway-Test. Injected tracer flows into the Liver-Factory; if it misses the gallbladder, the door is blocked.

cards.lore: Surface voltage measurement. Maps the depolarization wave traveling through the heart muscle.
cards.power: The Electrical-Witness. Writes the heart's playbook. Finds the STEMI-Fire and the Chaos-Quiver.

cards.lore: Spirometry. Differentiates Obs-the-Blocker (Asthma) from Res-the-Restrictor (Fibrosis).
cards.power: The Lung-Power-Gauge. Measures how much Air-Fuel the wrestler can blow and how floppy the lungs are.

cards.lore: Scalp electrophysiology. Records the summation of neuronal firing to detect rhythm ruptures.
cards.power: The Mind-Rhythm-Reader. Watches electrical storms in the Brain-Bunker to find the Silent-Seizure-Spark.

cards.lore: Electromyography. Differentiates Nerve-Deadness from Muscle-Wither.
cards.power: The Power-Line-Check. Pokes Muscle-Engines to see if Nerve-Wires deliver the move command.

cards.lore: Cytological sampling. The least-invasive way to get a look inside a suspicious mass.
cards.power: The Cell-Snatch. Takes a micro-sample to see if cells look like normal citizens or Malignant-Max-Punks.

cards.lore: Histological sampling. Seeing tissue architecture is essential for grading breast and prostate miners.
cards.power: The Structural-Sample. Takes a solid plug so the Patho-Detective can see how tumor miners are arranged.

cards.lore: Direct visualization + biopsy. Identifies the enemy while looking right at the damage scene.
cards.power: The Internal-Snatch. Grabs a piece of the Arena-Wall (Gut, Lung) to check for invasion.

cards.lore: Surgical removal. The final verdict on any suspicious wrestler skin spot.
cards.power: The Total-Removal. Takes the entire lump out of the ring, giving the whole story and fixing the match.

cards.lore: CSF analysis. The direct data line to the Central Nervous System.
cards.power: The Brain-Bunker-Report. Draws liquor from the spinal basement to see if Meningi-the-Riot is attacking.

cards.lore: Pleural fluid analysis. Differentiates Heart-Fail-Flood from Infection-Fire.
cards.power: The Drown-Relief. Drains fluid around the Lung-Balloons so the wrestler can breathe.

cards.lore: Peritoneal fluid analysis. SAAG tells you if the problem is pressure or invasion.
cards.power: The Ascites-Audit. Drains the Water-Belly to see if the liver factory is failing or if tumors are leaking.

cards.lore: Synovial fluid analysis. Essential for saving a joint from septic destruction.
cards.power: The Joint-Secret. Drains the swollen knee to see if the riot is caused by uric needles or bacterial punks.

cards.lore: Polymerase Chain Reaction. The microscopic megaphone for viral code scraps.
cards.power: The Ghost-Finder. Takes a tiny blueprint scrap and copies it millions of times until the enemy is visible.

cards.lore: Molecular cytogenetics. Lights up specific sequences right on the chromosome.
cards.power: The Code-Spotter. Uses a neon flashlight to find a specific genetic typo or missing page.

cards.lore: Laser-based cell counting. Identifies the phenotype of thousands of cells in seconds.
cards.power: The Army-Sorter. Shoots cells through a laser to find Leukemia-Punks by their unusual uniforms.

cards.lore: High-throughput sequencing. The final verdict on the genetic fate of the wrestler.
cards.power: The Source-Code-Master. Reads every single letter to find hidden glitches and future risks.

cards.lore: The master of all sensors. Don't use a Tesla-Titan when a Stetho-Listener can solve the match!
cards.power: The Tool-Strategist. Choose the fastest tool for the emergency, and the deepest tool for the mystery!

cards.lore: Use the gateway tool to see the subglottic squeeze and prepare for the breath-pipe.
cards.power: Deploy: Lar-the-Voice-Mirror.

cards.lore: Use the immediate-reveal tool to find the internal blood pool before calling the blade brigade.
cards.power: Deploy: FAST-the-Trauma-Seeker.

cards.lore: CT shows no bleed mist. Use DWI to find the trapped water signal of an acute stroke-stall.
cards.power: Deploy: DWI-the-Stroke-Spotter.

title: The Diagnostic Toolkit: The Detective's Gear
